service.description: The calculation a registered localization implements (its calculationServiceName): side-effect free, it takes the declared pay facts of one employment and period (each component's code, kind and amount, in the currency), the accumulation bases and the employee's profile, and answers itemized employee and employer amounts, each with its base, rate and explanation, and the findings that block a result or warn of one. It reads no record and writes none: no invoice, payment or employee data. The caller has checked the reader's payroll scope.

parameter.name: payFacts
parameter.description: Maps of componentCode, componentKindEnumId, amount and reimbursement (true for a line paying an expense claim, which is no pay to levy; impl-people P27)

parameter.name: items
parameter.description: itemCode, itemName, party (employee or employer), base, rate, amount, explanation

service.description: The demonstration localization (PlzDemonstration): a flat levy on the earnings among the pay facts, 2% from the employee and 1% from the employer, each rounded to the currency, and a finding (DEMONSTRATION_ONLY) that it is synthetic and not any jurisdiction's law. For preview only; no group bound to it can be live. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED).

The registered payroll localizations, by name: each its jurisdictions, coverage dates, release, required setup, outputs and whether it is a demonstration (never live). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: localizations
parameter.description: payrollLocalizationId, localizationName, jurisdictionText, coverageFromDateText, coverageThruDateText, releaseVersion, isDemonstration, requiredSetup, supportedOutputs, description
